bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
test -d "$root/.git" || exit 60
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 61
python3 - "$root" <<'PY'
import ast,pathlib,sys
s=(pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])/"scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py").read_text("utf-8")
t=ast.parse(s)
choices=[]
for node in ast.walk(t):
 if isinstance(node,ast.IfExp):
  cond=ast.get_source_segment(s,node.test) or ""
  if "link_registration_smoke" in cond or "link_rich_flow_smoke" in cond:choices.append(cond)
if len(choices)!=1:raise SystemExit(83)
if "link_photo_caption_smoke" in choices[0]:raise SystemExit(80)
raise SystemExit(81)
PY
